The only blocker row in this packet is source_row_id 839288 with raw identifier 'Investments Investments Total Investments - non-controlled/non-affiliated', source fair value 1,572,769,000, and no issuer, instrument, rate, maturity, principal, shares, or other leaf-position fields. The XBRL identifier itself is an exact total/header label: it contains duplicated Investments hierarchy text followed by Total Investments and an affiliation scope, and source_reconciliation_detail_samples show adjacent source-only rows such as Total Cash and Cash Equivalents and Total Portfolio Investments, Cash and Cash Equivalents with the same total-row semantics. A broad suppression rule would be unsafe, but an exact normalized total-header match is bounded and covered by existing false-positive tests for issuer-bearing rows.
